user_query: I want to explore different countries through webcams. Can you fetch the webcams in the bounding box of the desired location and display their images? Additionally, provide me with the map tile with English labels for the location.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of webcams within the specified bounding box of the desired location.
Retrieve the latest images from the fetched webcams.
Obtain a map tile for the specified location with English labels.
